_comment: STRUCTURAL FIXTURE — permanent test data, not a customer record.
Shape: two vessels (a boat and a PWC) where several lines are OPTIONAL and
the customer ticks them on the hosted page. Asserts BOTH states so the
optional-line recomputation path is exercised end to end: core-only (every
optional off, the default) and all-options (every optional on).
A deselected optional is excluded from the engine call entirely, so the two
states are separate engine computations, not arithmetic on one result.
title: Winter storage — boat + PWC
